summary: 2 of 14 tests regressed. Both passed on the parent commit and now fail 3 of 3 attempts. The new session cache is never invalidated, so logout leaves a live session and a company switch serves the previous company's rows.

findings.message: auth/switch-company.spec.ts:11 'switches to the second company' failed 3 of 3 attempts (passed on the parent commit). Expected 3 rows for company B, received 7 — the rows belong to company A. The session cache is keyed by session id and survives a company switch, so current_company_id() returns the stale company. This is cross-tenant data exposure reproduced by the suite.
findings.suggestion: Invalidate the cache entry on company switch, or key it by (session id, company id). Trace and video are at test-results/auth-switch-company-11/.

findings.message: auth/logout.spec.ts:6 'logs out and clears the session' failed 3 of 3 attempts (passed on the parent commit). Expected a redirect to /login, landed on /invoices — the cached session outlives logout because _session_cache is never evicted.
findings.suggestion: Evict the cache entry in the logout handler alongside the cookie clear.
